zh: 然后我问，你在那儿唱过歌吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And she was like, yes.
zh: 她说，唱过。

speaker: Unknown
en: I sang popular from Wicked.
zh: 我唱了《Wicked》里的 Popular。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, what?
zh: 我说，什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's crazy.
zh: 太疯狂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: She knows the pianist!
zh: 她认识那位钢琴家！

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been there for almost every Monday night in my 20s for three years.
zh: 我二十多岁的时候，几乎每个周一晚上都在那儿，去了三年。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was just like my safe haven.
zh: 那简直就像我的避风港。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a place I really love in SF and there's not really a place like that I have in LA.
zh: 那是我在旧金山真心热爱的地方，而在洛杉矶我没有一个那样的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's such a special place in my heart.
zh: 所以它在我心中是一个特别特别的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you know, we bonded, we really bonded through that moment.
zh: 而且你知道，我们因此结下了情谊，我们在那一刻真正建立了联结。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, Alaric was in my wedding musical.
zh: 还有，Alaric 参加过我的婚礼音乐剧。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you guys know,
zh: 如果你们知道的话——

speaker: Unknown
en: personal life and seen my vlogs before.
zh: 关注过我私人生活、看过我的 vlog 的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: You would know that I, at my wedding last year, had a surprise wedding musical and Alaric was in it.
zh: 你就会知道，在我去年的婚礼上，我搞了一场惊喜婚礼音乐剧，Alaric 参与了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He sent that musical video or maybe short form to Holly.
zh: 他把那段音乐剧视频，或者可能是短视频，发给了 Holly。

speaker: Unknown
en: So Holly was like, wait a minute, you're the girl who had the wedding that Alaric sang and he sent it to me last year.
zh: 所以 Holly 就想，等等，你就是那个办婚礼时 Alaric 唱了歌、他去年把它发给我的女孩。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like,
zh: 我觉得我深层、隐秘、不为人知的秘密是……

speaker: Unknown
en: So all the dots were connecting.
zh: 所有的线索都串起来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a crazy moment.
zh: 那是一个疯狂的时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anyways, I love her.
zh: 总之，我很爱她。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think we're soulmates.
zh: 我觉得我们是灵魂伴侣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Moving on.
zh: 继续往下说。

speaker: Unknown
en: As much as I love content creation and being in Los Angeles, I've always been a tech girl through and through.
zh: 尽管我那么热爱内容创作、热爱待在洛杉矶，我从来都是一个彻头彻尾的科技女孩。

speaker: Unknown
en: And being able to connect the bridge with content in Silicon Valley has been such a fun space to be in.
zh: 而能够把内容与硅谷之间架起桥梁，一直是一个特别好玩的领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think my deep, dark, dirty secret is that...
zh: 我觉得我深藏的、黑暗的、肮脏的秘密是……

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know why I said it like that, but I really believe in this format where we can deliver tech career business insights in a girly pop casual kind of way that doesn't make you feel like you're hustling and bustling.
zh: 我不知道我为什么要那样说，但我真的相信这种形式：我们可以用一种少女感、轻松随性的方式来传递科技、职业、商业方面的洞见，而不会让你觉得自己在疲于奔命。

speaker: Unknown
en: I try to deliver these conversations that are like deep, meaningful, educational, but in a way that isn't just for the tech
zh: 我努力传递这些对话，让它们有深度、有意义、有教育价值，但又不是只面向科技——

speaker: Unknown
en: tech people.
zh: 科技从业者。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like good for the rest of the world.
zh: 它对世界上其他人也是有好处的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel like I have two wolves in me.
zh: 我觉得我体内有两只狼。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is that sweet, happy-go-lucky content creator that doesn't take life too seriously.
zh: 一只是那个甜美、无忧无虑、不太把生活当回事的内容创作者。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the other one is a very type A ENTJ corporate person.
zh: 另一只是一个非常 A 型人格的 ENTJ 企业人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like that's who I am deep down inside, I guess.
zh: 我想，那大概就是我内心深处的那个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I'm so serious when it comes to work.
zh: 就是说，在工作这件事上我超级认真。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I feel like we're finally in a place with office trauma that we can bring on people who have both.
zh: 而且我觉得，经历了办公室创伤之后，我们终于来到了一个可以容纳兼具两者的人的时代。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know what I mean?
zh: 你们懂我的意思吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, we're not all just stuffy business people trying to mid-max and optimize and build for the shareholders.
zh: 就是说，我们不再全都是那种刻板的商务人士，只知道追求利益最大化、优化一切、为股东而建设。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've got life, identity, perspective, philosophy, and we just want to do a good job in our own careers.
zh: 我们有生活、有身份认同、有视角、有哲学，我们只是想在自己的职业里把事情做好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel like we are so early in our podcasting content journey.
zh: 我觉得我们的播客内容之旅才刚刚起步。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's okay, we're gonna build this up.
zh: 但没关系，我们会把它做起来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It takes years to build a strong podcast audience and a strong base.
zh: 建立起一个强大的播客受众和坚实的粉丝基础需要好几年。

speaker: Unknown
en: Consistency is king, and you know I'm gonna keep pushing my best.
zh: 坚持就是王道，而你们知道我会继续全力以赴。

speaker: Unknown
en: And maybe one day we'll make enough money and build a strong enough team where I'm not staying up until 5.30 a.m. trying to put together an interview.
zh: 也许有一天，我们能赚到足够的钱、组建起足够强大的团队，那样我就不用熬夜到凌晨五点半去拼一场采访了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Especially not while I'm in my third trimester of pregnancy.
zh: 尤其是在我怀孕进入第三孕期的时候可别再这样了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anyways, what do you think was the most fascinating part about this conversation?
zh: 总之，你们觉得这场对话最吸引人的部分是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel like it was a little bit different.
zh: 我觉得它有一点不一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's more current news.
zh: 它更偏向当下的新闻。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not as much general career as the previous episodes because we got to see a lot deeper on the product side of things.
zh: 不像之前几集那样偏泛泛的职业话题，因为我们在产品层面看到了更深入的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am so fascinated by cutting edge technologies.
zh: 我对前沿技术非常着迷。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have so many questions.
zh: 我有好多好多问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I never get to talk about this in my short form content.
zh: 我从来没机会在我的短视频内容里聊这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, a lot of companies don't really talk about their product in the way that we were able to with Holly, so we got really lucky here.
zh: 而且很多公司并不会像我们和 Holly 那样去聊自己的产品，所以我们这次真的很幸运。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me know what parts of it you really loved, what parts of it you think we should do more of, and how much you love Holly because I love her too.
zh: 告诉我你们最喜欢哪些部分、你们觉得我们应该多做些什么，以及你们有多爱 Holly，因为我也很爱她。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's all for now and I'll see you next week.
zh: 今天就到这里，我们下周见。

speaker: Unknown
en: Bye!
zh: 拜拜！
